claims.text: The hotel is in Napa Valley wine country, steps from Beringer Vineyards and minutes from downtown St. Helena.

findings.quote: Tucked in the heart of Northern California’s wine country, steps from Beringer Vineyards and minutes to downtown St. Helena, Alila Napa Valley is a journey of epicurean discovery
findings.note: The page title places the hotel in Napa Valley.

claims.text: The hotel is set next to a historic estate winery, with views of Napa Valley vineyards and mountains.

findings.quote: Enjoy sweeping vistas of Napa Valley vineyards and mountains, all set next to a historic estate winery.
findings.note: Covers both the winery setting and the views.

claims.text: The main building is a Georgian Revival-style mansion dating to 1905 that houses four guest rooms and the two restaurants.

findings.quote: The four rooms in the main historic building—an all-white Georgian Revival–style mansion dating back to 1905 that also houses the two on-site restaurants

claims.text: Rooms have bespoke Italian furnishings, luxury linens and spa-inspired bathrooms with rain showers and soaking tubs.

findings.quote: the rooms and suites include bespoke Italian furnishings, luxury linens and spa-inspired bathrooms with rain showers and soaking tubs.

claims.text: Streamside Suites have a balcony over York Creek with an outdoor dining set, a firepit and a soaking tub.

findings.quote: Unwind in wine country with this exquisite 948-square-foot room with York Creek views. Enjoy floor-to-ceiling glass doors that open onto a spacious balcony with an outdoor dining set for four, firepit, and soaking tub.

claims.text: Historic Manor rooms are in a restored manor house with town or vineyard views.

findings.quote: Experience an unforgettable Napa Valley getaway in a lovingly restored manor house with town or vineyard views.

claims.text: Spa Alila treatments use herbal remedies, basalt stones from the California coastline, obsidian gua sha stones and local handcrafted products.

findings.quote: Nature takes center stage with healing herbal remedies, basalt stones from the California coastline, obsidian gua sha stones and local, handcrafted ingredients and products.

claims.text: Wellness experiences include forest bathing, astrology readings after dark, new moon yoga and vineyard-view painting.

findings.quote: From forest bathing sessions and astrology readings after dark to new moon yoga and vineyard-view painting

claims.text: Guests can create a custom room and aura mist with an expert perfumer, using local botanicals.

you’ll craft your own custom room and aura mist using local botanicals.

claims.text: A tasting of historic cabernet sauvignon vintages can be hosted at the Rhine House or in a guest suite.

findings.quote: enjoy an exclusive tasting featuring historic cabernet sauvignon vintages. Compare wines across decades at the Rhine House or from your suite overlooking the vineyard.

claims.text: Reserved poolside cabanas include dining service, a lounging sofa and a private minifridge.

findings.quote: join the relaxing poolside vibe with your reserved cabana, including dining service, a dedicated lounging sofa and a private minifridge.

claims.text: Violetto, the hotel restaurant, blends French culinary techniques with Italian flavors, with a prix fixe menu featuring handmade pasta.

findings.quote: Violetto, our St. Helena hotel restaurant, blends the elegance of French culinary techniques with the warmth of Italian flavors for a refined dining experience.
